purpose: Durable evidence for the C3 full-suite verification requirement: the canonical environment has PRE-EXISTING local collection errors/failures, so C3 verification uses exact base/head failure-set equivalence under equivalent conditions with HEAD_NEW_FAILURES = 0.

conditions.method: Two identical fresh git worktrees on the same machine, same pytest flags: python -m pytest -q --continue-on-collection-errors -rf --tb=no

baseline_full_suite.note: 4 collection errors are pre-existing local-environment limitations (e.g. ModuleNotFoundError: polars in tests/test_jfp_v2_pr_c.py and 3 sibling files); they exist identically on canonical master fba39dfa.

head_full_suite.note: Includes the 13 new C3 structure tests, all passing.

equivalence.failure_set_relation: head_failed_set is a strict subset of baseline_failed_set (4 baseline-only failures were re-run at baseline and reproduce there, and PASSED at head under identical fresh-worktree conditions: environment/ordering-dependent flaky tests around DSH Stage-A one-episode activation registry projections, not C3 surfaces)
equivalence.baseline_flakiness_confirmation: Targeted rerun of the four affected v0r3-v0r6 activation test files at baseline (fresh worktree, same conditions) produced 9 failed / 46 passed in 404.9s, confirming these tests are environment/state-flaky at the baseline itself.
